question: Who holds the authority of transferring judges from one High court to another High Court?

options.text: The senior most judge of Supreme Court

solution:
The correct option is __**The President of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• President of India:-

 
 
• The** President of India** holds the authority of** transferring judges **from one High Court to another High Court.
 
• The president is elected by an electoral college consisting of the elected members of both houses of parliament and the elected members of the legislative assemblies of the states and union territories.
 
• The president serves a five-year term and can be re-elected .
 
• The President of India is the** head of the executive branch **of the government of India and is also the **Commander-in-Chief **of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **senior most judge of Supreme Court** is responsible for the** appointment of judges** to the Supreme Court.
 
• The **Chief Justice of India **is responsible for the **administration** of the Supreme Court and the High Courts.
 
• The **Law Minister of India **is responsible for the formulation and** implementation of laws and policies** related to the legal system of India.
